note: Both sets are accurate and keep the key conditions (Region 3, positive control gains, Ref. [10] design recommendation), and neither invents values. Set A's only weakness is redundancy (the second-order and generator-torque negative-damping claims each appear twice), while Set B duplicates the derivative-term claim and misses the response-type fact, so A has better coverage with no substantive errors.
